config.title: Who Could Have Checked?
config.sub: Security failures, replayed so you make the calls. Every case ends at the same question: where was the check, and who could have made it?
config.footer: Smoke-test course for the Trust Course Kit. The case is fictional.
questions: Who may change it, and how?
How would we know it changed?
Who checks the change, apart from the person who made it?
Is the safe way also the easy way?

1.name: When they ask nicely
1.desc: Requests that look routine and are not.

2.name: When it is already inside
2.desc: Access that spreads after the first door opens.

questionHints: Fails when no single person or team is named as the owner of the system.
Fails when anyone can change it, or the change route skips approval.
Fails when a change could happen and no log, alert or review would show it.
Fails when the person who made the change is the only one who checked it.
Fails when the secure route takes more effort than the insecure one, so people skip it.
